layers.purpose: Locate source text, freeze chart coordinates and define the real-world burden of each option atom.
Route palace/subject coordinates, star nature, sixty star systems and palace-specific expression.
Apply transformations, 144 body-use lookup and natal/decade/year/month activation.
Build stems/branches, ten-god roles, seasonal strength, structure, climate and structural changes.
Project luck-cycle timing and topic capability while preserving Bazi-specific evidence limits.
Arbitrate independent tracks, close real-world endpoints, compare every option pair and enforce runtime isolation.

CLASSICAL_QUANSHU_STATIC.role: Star nature, palace expression, combinations and classical pattern conditions.
CLASSICAL_QUANSHU_STATIC.limit: A classical phrase is a conditional tendency, not a guaranteed modern event.

ZHONGZHOU_STAR_SYSTEM.role: Read the complete star system and transformation-conditioned quality before topic projection.
ZHONGZHOU_STAR_SYSTEM.limit: Do not reduce the method to a single main star or count the same physical structure twice.

FLYING_STAR_LIANG.role: Track heavenly-stem transformations, self-transformations and Lu/Ji direction through changing time layers.
FLYING_STAR_LIANG.limit: Movement and salience do not by themselves prove actor, event type or completed outcome.

HELUO_FANGWAI.role: Use topic taiji, body/use, qi-number position, palace stem and heaven-earth-human layering as coordinate methods.
HELUO_FANGWAI.limit: These coordinate systems must not replace person routing, time activation or endpoint closure.

ONE_HUNDRED_FORTY_FOUR.role: A 12 body-palace by 12 use-palace lookup, further expanded by taiji point and transformation; comparable to a conditional dictionary.
ONE_HUNDRED_FORTY_FOUR.limit: A lookup hit is not a standalone prediction and must return to the actual chart, conditions and time layer.

BAZI_ZIPING.role: Move from seasonal qi and structure to role allocation, structural change, luck-cycle trigger and topic capability.
BAZI_ZIPING.limit: Useful-god, ten-god, clash, fu-yin or a shensha may not jump directly to an exact person, profession, disease or legal endpoint.

calendar_and_month_mapping.limit: Gregorian month, lunar month and solar-term month may not be substituted for one another. An unresolved boundary or convention blocks the affected flow-month conclusion.

ziwei_coordinate_integrity.limit: Interpretation may begin only after the coordinate receipt is internally reciprocal and reproducible.

ziwei_coordinate_truth_table.limit: Every namespace must have exactly twelve unique palaces before interpretation. Topic reasoning may reference the frozen table but may not regenerate coordinates or accept a partial subject-Taiji chart.

period_namespace_alignment.limit: Ziwei major periods and Bazi luck cycles may not share an unqualified label or range. Each track maps the reference year independently before fusion.

bazi_atomic_fact_ledger.limit: All Bazi atomic facts must be mechanically derived under one declared convention before interpretation. Option wording cannot repair, add or recalculate the ledger.

bazi_strength_structure_favorability.limit: Strength, pattern and favorability must share one complete option-blind evidence chain and cannot be reassigned to satisfy a question.

bazi_dynamic_relation_scope.limit: Historical event years are inactive validation anchors by default. Objects from different years may interact only under an explicit source-routed and object-bounded method.

result_dynamic_closure.limit: A result-bearing option cannot be ranked from natal capacity or general scene alone.

entity_nonexistence.limit: Severe or malefic symbolism is risk evidence, not standalone proof that an entity is absent or never existed.

event_specificity.limit: General evidence quantity, source count and school count do not outweigh an independent event-specific chain. Transmitted evidence must disclose every hop and is discounted against equally reliable direct same-axis evidence.

topic_palace_chain.limit: Auxiliary palaces and qi position refine or challenge the primary route; they cannot replace subject identity, time activation or endpoint closure.

cross_question_joint_candidates.limit: A joint matrix exposes combinations and contradictions; it does not turn one option into a fact for another question or reward a coherent story without independent evidence.

status_transition_state_machine.limit: Damage, pressure, separation or interruption may impair a state without ending it. Entry, maintenance and terminal exit each require their own transition evidence.

collaborative_hypothesis_revalidation.limit: User or model proposals remain hypotheses until independently checked against the frozen chart. Authority, confidence, agreement and narrative fluency are not evidence.

cross_case_hypothesis_quarantine.limit: A recurrence signature found in one discussion remains a zero-weight hypothesis. Neither one case nor same-case replay can promote it into a runtime rule.
